Over the course of your journey, you've seen plenty of the weaponry and technology used by the Fatui. As it turns out, they're also related to your latest assignment...

#### Go to the Zapolyarny Palace

**Paimon:** Your Majesty... Whoa, what's this?

**Anastasya:** You should be quite familiar with things of this sort, yes?

- **Traveler:** In a sense, I suppose...

**Anastasya:** Due to their operational needs, the Fatui are always equipped with cutting-edge weapons. I have appointed dedicated personnel to oversee weapons development and distribution.

**Anastasya:** Military affairs are ever-changing and brook no delay. As such, unless there are serious problems, routine matters need not be reported to me. Those in charge may decide for themselves.

**Paimon:** But since you've called us over today, does that mean something serious has come up?

**Anastasya:** Chayka, show them the Armory Palace's report.

**Chayka:** Yes, Your Majesty... Please take a look.

**Paimon:** ...The Armory Palace has developed a lightweight Landrover and intends to adapt it for civilian use to offset development costs... The matter being of great consequence, we humbly await Your Majesty's decision...

**Anastasya:** Such matters are normally left entirely to Pierro and Sandrone. They exercise their own judgment.

**Anastasya:** But since the letter itself says "of great consequence," we may as well inspect the Armory Palace ourselves.

- **Traveler:** You want us to accompany you?

**Anastasya:** Of course. I shall require a Councilor when it comes to armaments.

**Anastasya:** You have fought many battles, Traveler. Surely you are no stranger to weaponry.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** I'm all too familiar.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** I dabble, Your Majesty.

##### Shared continuation

**Anastasya:** Good. Then you will accompany me on the inspection.

**Anastasya:** Come with me once you are ready.

#### Accompany the Tsaritsa to the Armory Palace

**Paimon:** Ooh, it's Valeriy and Mitya!

**Valeriy:** Greetings, Your Majesty.

**Mitya:** Your Majesty, thank goodness you're here!

**Anastasya:** Hold on, let us hear the specifics first.

**Mitya:** As you saw in the report, the Armory Palace recently developed a lightweight Landrover, and we're preparing to adapt it for civilian use.

**Mitya:** But I really think we need to put it through another round of testing.

**Ordnance Officer:** Your Majesty! Please forgive me, I should have come out to receive you... Perhaps it is best I explain this myself.

**Ordnance Officer:** We were just about to submit this matter to Lord Jester for approval, you should've never have been troubled with it, Your Majesty. Please, allow us to handle it...

**Mitya:** But sir, you said yourself that both Lord Jester and Lady Marionette have been busy lately, and the tests would have to be postponed.

**Mitya:** That's why I invoked the contingency clause in the Armory Palace regulations and went straight to Her Majesty.

**Ordnance Officer:** Wha...?

**Anastasya:** Your signature and seal are on this report. Yet now you know nothing of it?

**Anastasya:** Pushkarskov. Are reports on vital military matters idle playthings to you?

**Ordnance Officer:** Yes...! Your Majesty! No. No, that's not... I... But my seal...

**Valeriy:** Sir, all reports from the Armory Palace must be first reviewed and stamped with your seal before they can be submitted.

**Ordnance Officer:** This... Yes, yes, I remember now...! Well, since you have already honored us with your visit, Your Majesty, I'll go arrange the test at once!

**Anastasya:** What exactly does this involve? Pushkarskov, you will stay and listen as well.

**Ordnance Officer:** As... As you command, Your Majesty.

**Mitya:** Your Majesty, when we test military equipment for civilian use, we mainly look for potential hazards. With this new Landrover, for example, we need to check whether it could injure the operator while running.

**Ordnance Officer:** Yes, and this kind of testing is dangerous. Exceedingly dangerous. Please, allow me to arrange for trained personnel...

**Anastasya:** Traveler, are you familiar with Landrovers?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** I've dealt with them before. No problem.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Never heard of them... but I should be fine.

##### Shared continuation

**Anastasya:** Good. Then Traveler will preside over the test. What say you, gentlemen?

**Mitya:** I think Traveler's the right person for the job.

**Ordnance Officer:** I... Yes, Your Majesty.

**Anastasya:** As there are no objections, it is settled. Mitya, prepare the test. Pushkarskov, you will accompany him and observe.

After making the necessary arrangements, you arrive at the testing site.

**Anastasya:** Come with me once you are ready.

#### Head to the testing grounds

**Mitya:** Your Majesty, this is the model intended for civilian use.

**Mitya:** Landrovers are powerful machines. Once the weapon systems are removed, they can be put to good use in mining, construction, and other industries.

**Anastasya:** So I understand. I leave the rest to you.

**Mitya:** Alright, let's start the test then! You ready, Traveler?

- **Traveler:** Leave it to me!

#### Shut down the lightweight Landrover

#### Report the test results to the Tsaritsa

You return to the Armory Palace with the Tsaritsa. Pushkarskov, who attempted to flee, has already been apprehended by the Druzhna.

**Vesna:** Stay right there!

**Danica:** ...Your Majesty, we have gathered sufficient evidence. As you suspected, Ordnance Officer Pushkarskov has indeed been conducting illicit business in secret.

**Danica:** Several of these so-called civilian Landrovers have already been sold, and the recipients are all private armed groups, fae gangs and the like.

**Danica:** He appears to have drawn up the civilian-model development plan as soon as his earlier arms smuggling was discovered, hoping to cover himself.

**Danica:** This plan did not, in fact, produce a genuine civilian model. It was just meant to legitimize the previous transactions.

**Ordnance Officer:** Your Majesty... I...

**Anastasya:** Utter folly.

**Paimon:** There's something Paimon doesn't get, though. Why would that guy agree to submit the report at all? Wouldn't that just be asking for trouble?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Do enough bad things...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** ...and sooner or later, you slip up.

##### Shared continuation

**Anastasya:** Now that this matter is settled, those who helped shall be rewarded in due course. Traveler, Paimon, go on ahead and inform your two friends.

**Paimon:** Oh... Oh! No problem, let's go, Traveler! Hehe, time to tell Valeriy and Mitya the good news.

#### Talk to Mitya and Valeriy

**Mitya:** I knew it. That thing was a civilian model in name only.

**Mitya:** He kept using the Harbingers' absence as an excuse to stall. This time, with Her Majesty the Tsaritsa there in person, he finally ran out of track to drag things out.

**Mitya:** But how did you get him to stamp that test request? The one going straight to Her Majesty?

**Valeriy:** I prepared dozens of reports on trivial matters in advance, stacked them, then slipped the report towards the back before handing him the whole pile.

**Valeriy:** Nobody likes reading reports. After going through a few pointless ones, I figured that he'd toss them to his secretary and have them all stamped just to get it over with.

**Mitya:** And if he had seen it?

**Valeriy:** I'd keep doing it. There'd always be a day he didn't.

**Paimon:** Ooh, so that's how you nailed him! Good thinking, Valeriy!

**Mitya:** Speaking of which, we have the two of you to thank for this as well.

**Mitya:** This kind of testing work isn't something just anyone can do. If we'd let Pushkarskov assign his own people, he probably would've found a way to pull the wool over our eyes.

**Mitya:** Good thing you two were involved. With you there, he had no way to wriggle out.

**Paimon:** But you could've just told Traveler directly! He's a Privy Councilor now. He can bring just about anything to the Tsaritsa's attention directly. / But you could've just told Traveler directly! She's a Privy Councilor now. She can bring just about anything to the Tsaritsa's attention directly.

**Valeriy:** It would be unjust to launch an investigation into a high-ranking official based purely on someone's speculation.

**Valeriy:** We needed to carry out the test and obtain solid evidence before we could secure a conviction.

**Mitya:** So many hoops to jump through. It's insanely complicated. No wonder nobody's tried to blow the whistle.

**Mitya:** Hahaha... Though, on second thought, maybe the persuasive power of Mora was just too great.

**Valeriy:** Arms dealing is definitely not a one-man operation. There must be more people involved. But...

**Anastasya:** Quite so. I have entrusted the Druzhna with investigating the rest of this matter. Your rewards will be delivered to your residences.

**Anastasya:** And once you have rested, you will join the investigation. You brought this matter to light. It is only fitting you see it through.

**Anastasya:** Should the need arise, you may both be summoned to take part in closed investigations. But do not let it trouble you. Simply answer the summons when the time comes.

**Mitya:** Yes, Your Majesty! You're right. We should finish what we've started.

**Valeriy:** ...Yes, Your Majesty.

**Mitya:** ...Actually, wait. What's a closed investigation?

**Valeriy:** You vanish for a while. And while you're vanished, you get to the bottom of everything.

**Mitya:** Wait! What if you can't crack the case?

**Valeriy:** I have never heard of a case that cannot be cracked.

**Mitya:** Ugh...

**Mitya:** Oh well. Her Majesty did say "should the need arise." Guess we'll deal with it when the time comes.

**Danica:** Your Majesty, we will need more time to establish exactly which fae gangs purchased these weapons.

**Anastasya:** There is no need to rush. One or two people could not have organized and carried out this arms smuggling alone. We must proceed patiently. Only then can we eliminate them, root and branch.

**Danica:** Yes, Your Majesty. I will confer with Vesna later.
